content.title: Review market instruments
content.description: An investment professional watches a compact market overview for key instruments, compares current values and daily percentage changes, and uses deterministic sparklines and hover emphasis to inspect movement without disrupting row sizing or neighboring content.
content.value: Provides quick external market context alongside portfolio-specific information.
criteria: The market overview tracks S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, and BTC/USD.
Each market row includes instrument, value, daily percentage, and sparkline.
Hovering emphasizes the row and subtly enlarges the sparkline region without changing row height or moving neighboring content.
